disruptions.name: Mumbai Port Strike

impact.description: Port gates and nearby access roads have restricted movement, affecting inbound medical supplies and container pickups.

recommendedActions: Use Bhiwandi and Navi Mumbai staging yards for temporary holding.
Prioritize cold-chain shipments and keep refrigeration units powered.
Reroute eligible deliveries through the Pune-Nashik corridor.
Confirm port access with the operations desk before dispatch.

disruptions.name: Pune-Mumbai Monsoon Congestion

impact.description: Heavy rainfall is slowing traffic near Lonavala and may add transit time to westbound routes.

recommendedActions: Add a weather buffer to Pune-Mumbai ETA calculations.
Monitor road conditions at the next driver check-in.
